final: WITH genre_counts AS (SELECT c.name AS genre, COUNT(*) AS genre_count FROM film_category AS fc JOIN category AS c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name), totals AS (SELECT SUM(genre_count) AS total_count FROM genre_counts), shares AS (SELECT g.genre, g.genre_count, 1.0 * g.genre_count / t.total_count AS share FROM genre_counts AS g JOIN totals AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.genre_count) AS average_genre_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_genre_share, AVG(s.share - a.value) AS average_excess_share FROM shares AS s JOIN average_share AS a ON a.value IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.value
